decisive_items: a mobile, smooth, oval, pedunculated mass originating from the left ventricular lateral wall
He had no prior medical history
response.rationale: A mobile, smooth, oval, pedunculated ventricular mass with focal contrast enhancement in an asymptomatic healthy patient is most consistent with cardiac myxoma; thrombus is less likely because it is typically avascular and occurs with predisposing factors, while papillary fibroelastoma overlaps in mobility but is usually valvular and less contrast-enhancing.

rejected.why: Thrombus is avascular and would not be expected to show focal contrast enhancement, and the patient has no predisposing cardiac or coagulopathic history.
